description: This file is a Python source file containing unit tests for the 'express' project template within the 'universalinit' code generator framework. It defines fixtures for setting up temporary directories and mock templates, and includes test functions that verify template initialization, project scaffolding, configuration loading, template variable replacement, and execution of post-processing scripts.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Creates and cleans up a temporary directory for testing.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Sets up a mock template directory with configuration and files for testing the express template.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Creates a sample project configuration object for testing.

methods.name: test_express_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of initial template information such as commands from the express template.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests the process of initializing a new project from the template and verifies directory structure and content.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Checks that the post-processing script is executed and completes successfully.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Ensures project configuration can be loaded correctly from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies that template variables within files are correctly replaced during project initialization.
